sourceVisualNotes: Actual six inventory references viewed. item3941 version65537 has a hashed opaque suffix; only declared-frame reference was inspected, not full-container or native-runtime validation. The sixth small hairclip is a round dark/silver ornament; any inner motif below is an original design interpretation, not a recovered source detail.

items.name: opera-jade-lantern
items.designBrief: One small ceremonial hanging BLUE-JADE round lantern, short warmgold suspension hook/top fitting, tiny goldcloud pattern on globe and a SHORT CRIMSON tassel underneath. No long pole, person or ground.

items.name: winged-sun-war-helm
items.designBrief: One open golden war crown/helmet with tall thin central red-jewel spire and TWO wide upturned blade-feather side wings, sharp V silhouette softened into rounded carved Daoist clouds. Open transparent face space, no wearer.

items.name: tidal-jade-crown
items.designBrief: One complete warmgold sea ceremonial crown with broad ribbed vertical central dome/crest, two upturned side horn fins and LONG cheek guards, tiny bluejade forehead gem. Lower transparent face opening, different from winged V helmet beside it; no wearer.

items.name: ivory-wing-heart-coronet
items.designBrief: A small icy ivory/lightcyan winged heart head ornament: ONE blue heart jewel at center, two layered white upward feathers on either side, fine warmgold fittings and palejade inner curls. No broad halo, hair or wearer.

items.name: azure-cloud-ward-shield
items.designBrief: One compact pointed-bottom SHIELD, deepblue/teal center, rounded silverivory rim and finegold rivets, original round jadegourd emblem in middle, slight threequarter angle, clear shield silhouette. No background halo or stats.

items.name: round-cloud-hairclip
items.designBrief: One tiny round charcoal/silver HAIRCLIP: ivory ring-shaped scalloped rim around darkcenter with a small transparent opening, short darkbrown clasp behind. New simple goldcloud engraving around rim, no character face or invented source insignia.
